propositions: Explicit review-plan on bugs with non-test file_impact must escalate to full LLM rubric with blocking enabled instead of forcing light advisory tier at both precheck and route_criteria seams
Gerrit DET criterion must block bug fixes exceeding 150 non-test lines lacking a current or code-drifted attestation, with cross-host opcert verification and teaching message
Attestation verification for the Gerrit criterion must read plan-review opcert records cross-host via opcert_from_record and trusted_env_keyring, never via own-env plan_review_status
Non-test line classification must consistently exclude tests/** and conftest.py paths, with the 150-line threshold as a single shared constant imported by both criterion and backtest
Bug claim-time exemption must remain unchanged; blast-radius routing must not require CLI flags or step-input schema changes
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must verify exact set equality: flagged set equals the 13 adjudicated-substantive commits with zero mechanical false positives
